verdict.rationale: The evidence does not document a Snowflake capability for versioning, reviewing, or rolling back automations such as tasks, pipelines, or dbt project deployments. Time Travel restores data and dropped objects, dbt Projects covers develop/deploy/orchestrate/observe, and Query History monitors executed queries. These are related features, not version history, change review, or rollback for automation definitions.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
